edges.act_citation_note: The instrument is believed to exist and nobody here has read it. That is what not-found means, and it is a weaker footing than every other station in this fixture stands on.
edges.parent_basis: The act recites the canons of the 1983 Code it replaces, so the instrument's own text draws the edge.
